claims.claim: Micron fiscal Q2 2026 revenue nearly tripled to 23.9 billion dollars
claims.checked_against: SEC EDGAR companyfacts, Micron CIK 0000723125, form 10-Q
claims.note: CORRECTED 2026-09-07. An earlier triage marked this WRONG and gave 8.71 billion as the actual figure. The filing says otherwise: the quarter ended 2026-02-26 reported 23.86 billion dollars, and the year-ago quarter ended 2025-02-27 reported 8.05 billion, which is a 2.96x increase. The video is right on both the number and the word 'tripled'. The 8.71 billion figure is fiscal Q1 2025, five quarters earlier.

claims.claim: Micron fiscal Q3 2026 guidance of 33.5 billion dollars
claims.note: Guidance is issued in an earnings release, not tagged in the filings, so it is not checkable from EDGAR alone. What IS checkable: actual fiscal Q3 2026 revenue was 41.46 billion, and the first three quarters of fiscal 2026 total about 78.96 billion. So 33.5 billion is neither the quarterly actual nor a plausible full-year figure for fiscal 2026. Do not repeat this number without the earnings release in hand.
